newsitem.title: USA: Koll stockholders OK recapitalization plan.
newsitem.headline: Koll stockholders OK recapitalization plan.

text.p: Koll Real Estate Group Inc Thursday said its stockholders approved a recapitalization program under which the company will exchange common stock for about $200 million worth of its public debt.

In a statement, the real estate development concern said under the plan it will combine class A common stock and series A preferred stock into one class of common by issuing 1.75 common shares for each outstanding share of preferred share. The company will then carry out a one for 100 reverse stock split.

An exchange offer for Koll's 12 percent senior subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due March 15, 2002, and its 12 percent subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due March 15, 2002, unless extended, is set to expire on June 23, 1997.
